'''Korlana Toryn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was the daughter of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jasso Toryn]].

==Biography==
When Toryn was a child, she became close to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]], a good friend of her father. She called him "Uncle Lanni" and thought of him as almost being a second father to her. When the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for ten years, between [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] and [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Toryn became very upset, as it meant that she could not contact Qel-Bertuk.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Toryn was sent by her father to stay on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], which was neutral in the conflict. He hired the [[heroes of Cularin]] to protect her, while she was there. After she arrived on Nar Shaddaa, she stayed at the hotel [[Bespin's Cloud]] and the heroes planned to meet her there. However, she left to visited ''[[Totor's Party Kave]]'', a [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] that was used as a nightclub. The heroes met with her there, but the barge was attacked and destroyed by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], who wanted to collect a [[Contract AA23|bounty]] that had been posted on the heroes.

A short time later, the bounty hunters captured Toryn and the heroes. However, the heroes were able to escape and they freed Toryn. The heroes then flew with Toryn to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where she went to stay under the protection of Master Qel-Bertuk and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
